headline: Türkiye and Russia Reaffirm $100 Billion Bilateral Trade Target in Istanbul
summary: Turkish Trade Minister Omer Bolat and Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak co-chaired an intergovernmental commission meeting in Istanbul, reaffirming a $100 billion bilateral trade target.
why: Bilateral trade pacts between emerging economic partners directly impact cross-border logistics, energy supplies, and industrial exports.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Reaffirming bilateral trade targets sets cooperative economic frameworks between nations.
